articles.title: June 8, 2025 NETGEAR appoints Technology Leader Charles (CJ) Prober as new CEO

articles.summary: Current CEO and Chairman Patrick C.S. Lo to Retire as Part of Planned Leadership Transition. The Board has appointed Charles (CJ) Prober, a senior technology executive, to succeed him effective immediately.
articles.title: Charles Prober as New NETGEAR CEO - NETGEAR
